announcements.body: The midsem schedule for CS501, CS503 and CS505 is live. Please review the seating plan and share any clash reports by Aug 5.

announcements.title: DSA Assignment 4 deadline extended to Aug 7, 11:59 PM
announcements.body: Given the hackathon weekend, the submission deadline for Assignment 4 (Graph Algorithms) is extended by 24 hours. Late penalty (10%/day) applies after.

announcements.title: Guest lecture: Graph Neural Networks in Production
announcements.body: Dr. Ritu Sharma (ex-Google Research) joins us online on Aug 12, 4 PM. Attendance counts toward the seminar series component.

announcements.title: Lab records — CS501: submission format reminder

announcements.title: Course feedback window opens Aug 14
